article.headline: Marcus Tankersley scores 17 to lead Alcorn State over Bethune-Cookman 70-61
article.description: — Marcus Tankersley scored 17 points as Alcorn State beat Bethune-Cookman 70-61 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Marcus Tankersley scores 17 to lead Alcorn State over Bethune-Cookman 70-61
article.story: LORMAN, Miss. -- — Marcus Tankersley scored 17 points as Alcorn State beat Bethune-Cookman 70-61 on Monday night. Tankersley also had five rebounds for the Braves (4-16, 4-3 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Keionte Cornelius made three 3-pointers and scored 13. Mike Pajeaud had 11 points. The Wildcats (7-13, 4-3) were led by Daniel Rouzan with 17 points. Tre Thomas added 16 points and six rebounds. David Onanina totaled eight points and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
